We need to determine SMILES of an organic molecule given no data. The task description says "Within a laboratory context, you have a sample of an organic molecule. Determine its SMILES notation carefully, using minimal but sufficient analysis." But we have no experimental data provided. Possibly we need to use tools to get data from the sample. The environment likely has a sample of unknown molecule; we can call measurement tools: mass_spectrometry_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, etc. We need to deduce structure.

We should start by measuring mass spectrum to get molecular weight. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra.
